7000:
[קָטַר] _vb_. dubious word; si vera l. appar. = **shut in**, **enclose** (𝔗 קְטַר, Syr. _Syriac_ **bind**, _Syriac_ **chain**);—
**Qal** Pt. pass. pl. חֲצֵרוֹת קְטֻרוֹת [[26-ezekiel.46.22|Ez 46:22]] **enclosed courts** (cf. interpr. in Levy NHWB, and _Syriac_ PS 3589), but rd. prob. קְטַנּוֹת **small**, 𝔊 𝔖 Co Toy Berthol Krae.
